components.name: LLM Client
components.purpose: Requests typed tools and consumes results

components.name: Relay Server
components.purpose: Authenticates and routes device sessions without inbound PC ports

components.name: PC Agent
components.purpose: Verifies signed requests and delegates only locally authorized capabilities

components.name: Command Protocol
components.purpose: Defines signed expiring command envelopes and active-process replay checks

components.name: Policy Engine
components.purpose: Makes automatic allow approval-required or deny decisions at the user device

components.name: Local Capability Executor
components.purpose: Executes bounded filesystem process and Git operations after policy authorization

data_flows.meaning: automatic allow only; privileged requests remain approval-required
bounded execution result and audit metadata

external_boundaries.name: Public network
external_boundaries.contract: All remote device traffic is outbound from the agent and must be authenticated before execution.

external_boundaries.name: Local filesystem and process boundary
external_boundaries.contract: Filesystem operations use Go os.Root; process execution requires an executable allowlist, bounded output and timeout, trusted workspace CWD, and explicit environment.

external_boundaries.name: LLM provider API
external_boundaries.contract: Provider output is untrusted intent and cannot directly authorize privileged device operations.
